title: Dungeon Capital, my own game project, is now live on Google Play
author: Powerful-Storm-9092
selftext:
After losing my CNC job, I realized that I wanted to build something of my own.

I've always been a gamer and also pretty obsessed with the stock market, so at some point I thought: why not try building my own game?

It all started with the idea of making a stock market game, because in my opinion there simply aren't enough games of this kind.

A lot of games today are built around creating visible progress as quickly as possible — more resources, more money, bigger numbers.

Dungeon Capital is meant to be different.

The idea is to get rich slowly, more in a Warren Buffett-style way. Buffett is also one of my personal inspirations when it comes to investing in real life.

So I sat down at my PC and started learning the basics of game development. Mockups, prototype, alpha — there was a lot to learn.

AI tools helped me a lot along the way. In my opinion, especially as a solo developer, they have become incredibly useful if you want to bring a larger project to market within a somewhat realistic timeframe.

But the core systems, the economic ideas, the direction of the game and especially the world and economic news behind Dungeon Capital are things I've spent a lot of time thinking about and shaping myself.

Dungeon Capital is now finally live on Google Play.

I'd obviously be really happy if some of you gave it a try.

Google Play:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dungeoncapital.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dungeoncapital.game)

Maybe I'll see some of you on the investment leaderboard. :)

Cheers,

Miodri Games



AI Disclosure: As a solo developer, I used AI assistance for code structure/UI development and generating visual assets. The game's core design, systems, logic, and economics were designed by me, and all written world/news content (Dungeon Insider) was written by a professional human author.
